cohort: 60 intended parents and 63 gestational carriers undergoing gestational surrogacy treatment at the VU University Medical Centre over a 10-year period
finding: Gestational surrogacy treatment in a multidisciplinary team setting in the Netherlands demonstrated effective results, with a 55% live birth rate, but an increased risk for hypertensive disorders and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Labor was induced in 52.9% of surrogate mothers, and the Cesarean section rate was 8.8%.
